title: Elkhart Coach: WHEELCHAIR LIFTS/INTERLOCK BELT (41 affected)
summary: ELKHART COACH HAS NOTIFIED NHTSA OF A DEFECT IN CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES FITTED WITH RICON PUBLIC USE LIFTS.
